youtube.title: WINSTON PETERS
youtube.summary: Paul Brennan speaks with Foreign Minister Winston Peters about New Zealand First's health policy, which links diet and chronic disease to a wider critique of the medical system's reliance on pharmaceuticals. Peters points to vaping and reduced GST on whole foods as evidence for his approach, praises RFK Jr.'s health advocacy, and reflects on New Zealand's nuclear-free legacy and the shifting global security order. Discover more from Winston Peters on X , Facebook and Instagram For election news that matters, get RCR Bites FREE every weekday

youtube.title: FIONA ANDERSON
youtube.summary: Paul Brennan speaks with Fiona Anderson, manager of the Piha Campground, about the toll of its extended closure over flood risk. Fiona details her decades of on-the-ground safety measures, the conflicting flood models behind the council's decision and the near-4,000-signature petition backing her. She warns that forcing campers elsewhere will only push them into freedom camping outside residents' homes and questions why a single tragedy elsewhere should dictate Piha's fate. To sign Cindy Baxter's petition | Don’t Close our Beloved Piha Campground For more on Piha Campground Check out some RCR content on Managed Retreat For news that matters, get RCR Bites FREE every weekday

youtube.title: KEN TURNER
youtube.summary: Paul Brennan talks with Waitākere Ward Councillor Ken Turner about Auckland Council's push to close Piha Campground over flood risk. Ken argues the modelling behind the closure inflates future development scenarios to absurd levels, and questions whether liability concerns are driving the decision more than genuine safety. He warns that closing the campground would simply push freedom campers onto less-managed public land, with a local board decision looming this week. youtube.title: PERRY TROTTER
youtube.summary: Rodney Hide talks with Perry Trotter about the Holocaust Museum exhibition he and his wife Sheree built in Auckland, open to the public for just four days after a health setback shortened its run. They discuss the power of survivor testimony, the adaptable nature of antisemitism through history, media bias in coverage of Israel and why Perry believes today's climate uncomfortably echoes the 1930s. The exhibition is open to the public between 22 and 26 September. For more information visit the Holocaust Foundation

youtube.title: APOSTATE ARI
youtube.summary: Maree Buscke speaks with detransitioner and commentator Ari, known online as Apostate Ari, about his path out of transition and into public advocacy. Ari traces his story from childhood trauma and a diagnosis he now rejects, through public backlash after breaking from trans orthodoxy, to finding refuge within the Christian community. The conversation ranges across gender ideology's history, women's sports, parental rights, and the cultural reaction to Sydney Sweeney. Discover more from Apostate Ari on: Facebook Instagram X YouTube XX-XY Athletics Substack

youtube.title: LYNDA WHARTON
youtube.summary: Paul Brennan speaks with Lynda Wharton of Health Forum NZ about the country's only study into long-term myocarditis and pericarditis outcomes following Pfizer's mRNA vaccine. Lynda details how Health New Zealand held the 2024 findings for years before publishing, then made no changes to the care pathways its own study flagged as broken. The two discuss underdiagnosis, testing gaps and the lasting breakdown in public trust. To see the original report from Te Whatu Ora (Health NZ) | Long-term outcomes of myocarditis and pericarditis following vaccination with Comirnaty (Pfizer/BioNTech COVID-19 vaccine) For more from Lynda Wharton, visit The Health Forum NZ or find them on Facebook and X Check out RCR's Alia Bland and Katie Ashby Koppens | What officials knew about myocarditis for teens
